description: Seventy-five pellets rattle in a little tin. You only need a few.

events.text: [trip]Your stomach rolls hard. Mescaline always makes you pay the toll at the door first.[/trip]
[trip]The nausea is just the door you have to walk through. You breathe, and walk through it.[/trip]
[trip]Everything is edged in shimmering gold, as if the world were a coin held to the light.[/trip]
[trip]Geometric patterns bloom across every wall, precise and ancient and alive.[/trip]
[trip]A desert wind you cannot feel moves the shadows in long slow waves.[/trip]
[trip]An old voice, patient as stone, tells you a story in a language you were born knowing.[/trip]
[trip]The gold begins to cool. The patterns slow their turning, satisfied, and start to still.[/trip]
[trip]The desert folds itself back into four plain walls. You feel older, and steadier, and very tired.[/trip]

phases.comedown_message: The gold cools out of the air. The visions settle, unhurried, back into ordinary matter.
phases.comeup_message: Your stomach knots and your skin prickles. The long climb is starting.
phases.end_message: You come all the way down, wrung out and quietly rearranged.
phases.peak_message: The nausea burns off and the world opens up gold and geometric and endless.

effects.onset_message: The colours arrive first, and they have opinions.

name: Mescaline
